name: unrest
description: The conflict between the orders, made observable: a grip/heat/pressure ledger per derived city block, the perceivable signals a band crossing produces, and the incidents that stage on top of them. Phase 1 complete (1a-1d). Phase 2 adds the favour seam — an `unrest_incident` condition shape, so an authored repeatable quest can be offered and turned in only while there is something live to respond to. The plugin itself never moves reputation; the quest's own ADJUST_REPUTATION reward does, which is what keeps the sim from becoming an invisible alignment ledger. Phase 3 adds the other two orders as DRIVERS into the same ledger rather than as participants in it: eligibility becomes a registry keyed on an authored `flags.driver` (roles.js), because phase 1's band-and-signal gate is correct for the two orders that fight over ground and wrong for both that do not. The Null's `vendetta` reads GRIP and never the band, so its target is the street the authority has already finished pacifying; the Wildblood's `incursion` reads only the clock, has no local precondition of any kind, and bursts heat without ever touching pressure so it leaves no baseline behind. The Exodus stay withdrawn and stage nothing. No new scalar, no new table, no new verb.

config.BLOCK: 12 — the cell is a 12x12 square of grid coordinates (blocks.js)
config.flagKey: unrest_ledger — the one world_flags key this plugin writes, and it is the only writer
config.SIGNAL_WINDOW_MS: 6h — how long a perceivable signal stays answerable, which is what rule 1 gates an incident on (signals.js)
config.MAX_LIVE: 3 — simultaneous incidents CITYWIDE, not per cell (incidents.js)
config.VENDETTA_GRIP: 25 — the grip a cell must carry before the Null will hit what is bolted to it (roles.js). Never a band, so a pacified cell qualifies
config.NIGHT_FROM/NIGHT_TO: 22:00-04:00 — the only precondition an incursion has (roles.js)
config.INCURSION_BURST: 35 — heat put in by a raid. Never pressure, or the Wildblood become a permanent tenant

dataSchema.note: The LEDGER has no table: one versioned world_flags blob, RAM-authoritative with write-behind, because ~10 cells x 4 numbers does not justify a schema change, a registry entry and a read-tier decision. Band memory, the signal record and every live staging are RAM only, deliberately — rule 6 persists the ledger and never the incidents. world_events takes one audit row per staging and is not the ledger. Favours add NO state of their own: the gate is a live-incident lookup, because an instanceId does not survive a restart and anything remembered about a specific staging is a thing that can outlive it. Phase 3 adds none either: the vendetta reads grip that is already there, and the incursion's target cell is DERIVED from the night rather than rolled and stored, so two players agree on where they came in and a restart cannot contradict it.
